name: My Logimouse
author: Ormus Solutions
description: Fork of Omalogimouse: owns its Solaar-backed service directly instead of looking it up via the shell's cross-plugin service bridge, so it works under a custom (non-first-party) bar. Battery, DPI, MagSpeed, acceleration, and button actions for Logitech MX Master mice.

barWidget.description: Logitech MX Master battery, acceleration, and button binds
